messages.subject: plotNuse question -- make multiple plots?
parts:
Hi, I'm posting this question from Amrita so that my reply is on the
list (I have a reply, so need to respond). Best, Elizabeth

We are getting the RLE NUSE plots, but for >120 samples, the plot is
kind of unreadable, as you can't make out which samples gave the
outliers (showing bad sample ?)... aroma.affymetrix doesn't have the
option of plotting RLE NUSE for some specified samples (as in usual
affyPLM package). We are trying to figure out how to do that, then get
the plots for 10 samples at a time...

--Amrita.

messages.author: 43e2e19dd6bd2992
messages.subject: Re: plotNuse question -- make multiple plots?
parts:
Hi Amrita,
plotNuse has been updated since last spring so that it returns
(invisibly) the necessary information to plot the boxplot using the
function 'bxp'. This means it's in the format of the output of a call
to boxplot(). You can see in the help pages for boxplot the components
of the output; just modify this output so it contains just the arrays
you want. While you are at it, you can also change the order of the
boxplots to group them differently, etc. But you do have to save the
output: x<-plotNuse(...).
Best,
Elizabeth
